### {{< fa dog >}} Outside of Work

I grew up in Wisconsin—Go Pack Go! I like to read, listen to podcasts, and [puzzle](https://myspeedpuzzling.com/en/player-profile/0193cd4b-faa8-7252-aff3-96fdfc47cf9c). I recently took a beginner crochet class and am hooked! My favorite TV show is *Survivor*.

My partner Matt and I enjoy playing cribbage, listening to live music, and walking our Giant Schnauzer, Blu—short for Blugold, a nod to where we met at UW–Eau Claire.
